# changedetection Provider

Terraform provider for changedetection.io

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "changedetection" {
  endpoint = "http://localhost:5000/api/v1"
  api_key  = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `apikey` (String, Sensitive) The changedetection.io API Key. May also be provided via CHANGEDETECTION_API_KEY.
- `endpoint` (String) The changedetection.io API Endpoint. May also be provided via CHANGEDETECTION_ENDPOINT.
